record_title: Eight-state barrier for Markov positivity of the [2/2] Padé map
scientific_context: For the fourth-order [2/2] diagonal Padé map r(hQ), every fixed CTMC generator on at most seven states has a positive small-step neighborhood, while an eight-state pure-birth generator loses entrywise positivity for every sufficiently small positive step. For the explicit unit-rate witness the exact stochasticity set is {0} union [h0,2sqrt(3)], where h0=0.596640561867... is the unique positive root of 7h^6+126h^5+840h^4+2520h^3+3024h^2-1728.
limitations: Exact arithmetic, finite real CTMC generators, row convention, and end-step positivity only. The seven-state guarantee is local for each fixed generator, not a uniform dimension-only CFL bound. The exact global step-size window is for one pure-birth witness. No claim is made for internal stages, nonlinear systems, floating-point behavior, other Padé orders, or computational performance. Full theorem-level comparison with the 2026 Itkin-Kazbek preprint and end-to-end inspection of the 1986 van de Griend-Kraaijevanger paper remain residual originality risks.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone SymPy/NumPy verification of the Padé coefficients, eight-state pure-birth map, mass conservation, absorbing-column factorizations, and exact positivity boundaries.
Deterministic output of the symbolic and numerical boundary verification.
